boundedDecision: No remaining confirmed blocking experience defect in the supplied Library lifecycle increment. Four preflight blockers and final light-Library capture/privacy-document concerns are resolved within observed/source-corroborated bounds. This review is not Sounding Line software acceptance, owner/product acceptance, protected integration or whole-overhaul completion.
objective: Stable durable working identity; explicit reusable membership and named retry-safe copies; independent environment definitions; typed organized Library, immutable history and truthful recovery.

evidenceVerification.method: All fifteen original PNGs inspected at native size; all eleven supplied WEBM recordings inspected through 2fps start-to-terminal chronology samples. Critical error/recovery/copy/environment states supplemented with 8fps frames. Not continuous every-frame viewing or new runtime replay. Gray/blank startup frames remain part of originals; every recording has substantive application frames. Derived contact sheets stored only in reviewer temporary directory. No builder acceptance matrix used as acceptance authority.

engineeringSupport.comment: Original source-bound run and test assertions inspected; pass counts do not substitute for rendered judgments. Parent reports docs/catalog checks pass; reviewer made no generator/runtime/source mutation.

composition.observation: Large canonical room canvas remains central between the Library and Inspector. The independent environment workspace gives its canvas the full laptop section and stacks it above editing on phone; no duplicate environment overlay covers it.

hierarchy.observation: Scene/original-asset/environment headings, working-vs-Saved membership, and current-vs-version cards separate identity from reuse. Save to Library and Save as new are separate explicit actions.

typography.observation: Heading, field and card text is legible at native desktop/laptop sizes. Secondary dates/counts and tool captions are small; phone scene title truncates, while definition names remain readable in cards/editor.

spacing.observation: Desktop columns preserve gaps and card groups. Light phone filters stack with useful separation; the independent environment header wraps above a large canvas. Its full-page editor is long and requires scrolling.

controls.observation: Search, View, Type, card actions, version picker, Use in current scene and Versions have specific visible meanings. Environment workspace exposes all seven Select/Move/Rotate/Scale/Grid/Clamp/Surfaces tools. Historical copy uses a name form and distinct create/cancel actions.

contrast.observation: Light Library is actually open in the final laptop capture with dark blue text on white/pale blue and consistent outline controls. Dark cards, labels and blue focus rings are readable; small footer/status text remains less prominent. No quantitative contrast audit was independently run.

consistency.observation: Saved and Environment subsets use the same search/filter/card/action language and blue workstation vocabulary. Environment-only canvas now reports room features rather than hidden adapter objects; original asset header is distinct from Scene.

states.observation: Populated Saved, empty Saved-after-archive, Collections, Favorites, empty-shell setup, immutable preview, saving/failure and retained/conflicting recovery appear. No success claim is inferred from a red failure notice.

responsive.observation: 1440 desktop, 1366 laptop and 390 phone media preserve task context. Laptop room tools fit without former Grid cutoff. Phone Library uses a scrollable overlay; phone environment stacks canvas and editor. Header title truncation/action-strip density and full-page captures limit simultaneous-access claims. No physical phone/landscape matrix is renewed.

keyboard.observation: Frozen visible-control test uses Shift+F10/Escape for Library actions and Ctrl+Z/Ctrl+Y for environment history. Source suspends parent scene keys in environment/modal contexts and environment handler ignores native fields. Recorded automation supports these bounded alternatives; all keyboard paths and assistive technology are not qualified.

focus.observation: Setup close and active fields show blue focus indication. Keyboard context-menu test checks restoration to its action trigger. Named-copy form visibly focuses its name. No independent screen-reader or exhaustive tab-order test.

feedback.observation: Failure banner says work is retained and exposes retry/review. Recovery distinguishes saved revision from retained edits. Stale room recovery ends in a changed-in-another-window conflict, retaining rendered room. Saved membership and version totals are separate from ordinary working-draft persistence.

motion.observation: Chronology shows loading/preparing, actual room appearance, version dialogs and document switches without decorative motion obscuring actions. Full clips were sampled at 2fps start-to-terminal; critical copy/recovery/environment transitions also at 8fps. This supports lifecycle transitions, not animation interpolation or exact human dwell/latency acceptance.

continuity.observation: Working edits remain on one identity, named copy becomes a separate scene, environment original editing/return keeps originating scene snapshot, and copied compass instance survives original archive. Reload retained edits and two-tab conflict retain distinct intent; database assertions corroborate identity counts and source preservation.

complexity.observation: Typed View/Type filters and per-definition menus reduce duplication. Version history locates immutable actions together with a read-only canonical preview; named copy confirmation makes fork intent concrete. Many phone fields and options still require substantial scrolling.

role-outcomes.observation: Synthetic Creator authors durable working Scene, deliberately saves membership, copies by name, organizes, previews immutable history, independently edits/reuses an Environment and edits one pinned Asset instance. Media plus isolated API/database assertions support this bounded software outcome, not every owning-contract journey or all modes.

fallbacks.observation: Injected unavailable/lost-ack saves retain work and provide retry/review/named salvage rather than automatic forks. Stale CAS continues to reject overwrite. Empty manual environment creation does not need provider inference. Browser-storage refusal, provider/photo failures and renderer failure are not freshly qualified by this packet.

repairHistory.observation: Final laptop canvas fills section, all seven tools inside bounds; source has child canvas height100%. Environment-only footer reports features and one selection hint. Earlier cace production pass remained rejected for clipping.
Retained room reload/review ends with explicit CAS conflict; saved newer name stays unchanged per isolated assertion. Handler restores original recovery revision before applying retained data.
Environment CtrlZ/Y changes its own name/history and scene remains unchanged per fixture assertion; parent shortcut handler now skips environment workspace and modals.
Failed first-version copy followed by named second-version confirmation opens Version two object. Payload cache is per-version, retained for retries.
Final laptop-light still actually displays Library; prior b620 closed panel is not accepted as light Library evidence.

sourceCorroboration.observation: Durable membership separate from version-zero persistence; Save As retains new identity and exact operation digest, does not clone on retry.
Environment use embeds independent snapshot binding and refuses changed attached supports; no propagation from subsequent original edits.

Full GET inventory derives use counts/last-used timestamps/per-version pins from current/released scene bindings and Chronicle usages. Initial lower-level zero/null defaults are overwritten by this consumer projection.
